scope: Unclassified mixed organic waste is currently traded. Species-of-origin premiums are reserved until inhabitants and individual waste lots have auditable species provenance.

species.notes: Mineral-tolerant industrial biochemists who recover exotic catalysts from biological residues.

species.notes: Wetland-adapted agricultural cultures using fermented organic feedstocks in controlled ecological systems.
